priority_1_critical.item: Manual UI testing required for F1-F4 features
priority_1_critical.reason: Automated Playwright testing could not complete due to session expiration and complex navigation. Backend endpoints are verified working, but UI flows need manual verification.
specific_flows: F1-1: Multi-color variant creation (Tambah Varian → select style → add 2-3 colors → Auto-generate SKU → verify SKU format {STYLE}-{COLOR_CODE}-{SIZE} → Save → verify N variant cards created)
F1-2: Inline color creation ('+ Warna baru...' → fill form → Save → verify immediate availability in dropdown)
F1-4: SKU audit panel (create variant with wrong SKU via API → verify banner appears → click 'Perbaiki SKU' → verify SKU corrected)
F3-2: Measurement column rename (Tech Pack → Ukuran tab → rename column 'XL' → 'EXTRA L' → Save → Reload → verify values still present)
F4-1: Hybrid HPP arithmetic (HPP Calculator → mix Master/Techpack/Manual lines → verify Total biaya material = Σ all line costs)
F4-2: Override with mandatory reason (HPP → Master line → check 'timpa harga' → change price without reason → verify error → add reason → verify success)
F4-4: Backward compatibility (create old-style HPP via API → verify totals unchanged in UI → verify 'dokumen lama' badge)
